bio.text: Ken Calvert represents California's 41st Congressional District in the U.S. House and is on the November 3, 2026 ballot in California's 40th District; the congressman was first elected to Congress in 1992.

Calvert was born in Corona, California, in 1953, graduated from Corona High School in 1971, and earned an A.A. from Chaffey College (1973) and a bachelor's degree in economics from San Diego State University (1975).
Before Congress Calvert was a small business owner in the restaurant and real estate industries.
